title: MIB generator allow list
description: Names each Mist GET operation that reaches the MIB, and the scope of the readings it makes. An operator changes the selection by editing this file only.

version.description: The format version. The loader stops when it reads a version it does not know.

entries.description: One entry for each selected operation. The default holds the three the gateway reads today.

operation_id.description: The operationId of a GET operation in the OpenAPI file. The run stops when the file does not hold it, or when the operation is not a GET.

scope.description: The Mist object the readings describe. The value must be a member of MetricScope.

notes.description: Why the operator selected this operation. Written for a person, in Simplified Technical English.
